intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文喜剧线记忆：Rex 过去在大门外面叫，因为想进花园；丈夫训练它用脚爪按门闩，让它自己进来；Rex 成了开门专家，却又在花园里叫，想让别人放它出去；后来它把这个技巧玩成了新的进出循环。读的时候注意 used to、would、until、so that、As soon as 和“进来/出去”的方向对比。

sentences.text: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我们家的狗 Rex 过去常坐在大门外面叫。Used to 表示过去常常，front gate 是房子外面通向花园的小门，最后是 bark，狗叫。

sentences.text: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：每次它想进花园，就一直叫到有人开门。Every time 引出反复条件，would bark 是过去反复动作，until 说明叫到什么时候停止。
focus_words: wanted to come into the garden

sentences.text: As the neighbours complained of the noise, my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：因为邻居投诉 noise，丈夫花几周训练 Rex 用 paw 按 latch，把自己放进来。长句要按原因、训练、动作、目的四块读。

sentences.text: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Rex 很快成了开门专家。Expert at 后面接 doing，这里是 opening the gate，读出一点 comic praise。

sentences.text: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：这次它叫，是为了让人把它放出去。This time 读出反转，so that 表目的，let him out 和前面的 let himself in 方向相反。

sentences.text: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：它一从外面开门，就进花园，等门关上。As soon as 是一……就……，until the gate shuts 是等到门关上为止。

sentences.text: Then he sits and barks until someone lets him out.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：然后它坐下叫，直到有人把它放出去。Then 连接下一步，barks until someone lets him out 是循环里的核心动作。

sentences.text: After this he immediately lets himself in and begins barking again.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：之后它马上又把自己放进来，并再次开始叫。Immediately 要读出“马上”，lets himself in 和 begins barking again 把笑点循环起来。
